headline: Olavis Wake Flares as Gutter and Expanse Hold Hot
war_summary: Three hours on the wires have shifted the weight of the fighting. Olavis Wake, silent in the last edition, now reports eight changes in two hours around Iltaku and Kulkue with nearly three thousand casualties in that span and holdings at three Warden, one Colonial and one neutral, while Pari Peak likewise shows six changes in two hours at Pariah and Itaan at the same division. Gutter remains the day's busiest board with eighty-three changes in twenty-four hours, seven in the last two, around Kuoppa and The Parras at two Warden, three Colonial and two neutral, and Weathered Expanse follows with fifty on the day, six in two, around Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch at four Warden, three Colonial and two neutral with heavy losses on both sides. Stlican Shelf adds two in two and eleven on the day at Breaker Town, and Marban Hollow one in two and twenty-one on the day at Oster Wall. Nevish Line, Palantine Berm, Linn Mercy and Farranac Coast record no change in two hours, while Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle still show heavy daily casualties without a recorded change.
